verdict.summary: The reconciliation is fail-closed around marker authentication and duplicate issue claims, preserves unmapped and unparsable input, performs only one-way close synchronization, and writes atomically. The workflow keeps credentials scoped, rebuilds the derived snapshot from main, and avoids creating an uncheckable GITHUB_TOKEN-authored PR. The hermetic self-test exercises the load-bearing authentication, preservation, close, append, idempotence, serialization, and ambiguity paths and passes at the PR head. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect requiring changes was found.
